overview: The Villas at Disney's Grand Floridian are Disney Vacation Club rooms in a Victorian-style building next to the main hotel. They share the Grand Floridian's restaurants, pools and monorail.
suits: Families who want Grand Floridian elegance with a kitchen and more space.
rooms: As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.
pools: Guests use the Grand Floridian's pools, including the Beach Pool right next to the villas.
dining: Guests use the Grand Floridian's restaurants, including Narcoossee's, 1900 Park Fare and Gasparilla Island Grill.
pros: Walk, monorail or boat to Magic Kingdom
tips: Use the walkway to Magic Kingdom.
Read our Grand Floridian guide for first-hand tips.
bestFor: Families who want villa space at the Grand Floridian.
